title: 3306. Count of Substrings Containing Every Vowel and K Consonants II

examples.explanation: There is no substring with every vowel.
The only substring with every vowel and zero consonants is word[0..4], which is "aeiou".
The substrings with every vowel and one consonant are: word[0..5], which is "ieaouq". word[6..11], which is "qieaou". word[7..12], which is "ieaouq".
